text:
mike: RFC follow-up: propose "local-governor" pattern for Dedicated pools: control-plane issues periodic intents, operator enforces local token-buckets and can react quickly.
elaine: I like the split. Key Q: who owns preemption when local burst is exhausted but control-plane still claims budget?
hugo: Two-token model: steady_budget (control-plane) + burst_quota (operator). Operator may consume burst_quota up to configured cap, then must reconcile and decrement steady_budget via a ledger call.
mike: Ledger sketch: POST /v1/pool-ledger/apply {pool_id, shard, intent_id, delta_steady, ttl_seconds} control-plane must send monotonic intent_id and operator ignores stale ids.
elaine: Smoothing: operator must limit ramp to 20% of current prewarm per 30s window; EWMA (alpha=0.3) as optional smoother to avoid step changes.
hugo: Failure-mode: if control-plane unreachable for >120s operator enters fallback_mode: reserve X% for critical_tenants and clamp burst_quota to a low watermark; emit dedicated_fallback_mode metric and an alert.
mike: Metric contract (labels: pool,shard,region,tenant): dedicated_headroom_slots, dedicated_burst_tokens, dedicated_intent_id_last_seen, dedicated_fallback_mode (0|1). Also emit traceable preempt.event entries with minimal searchable fields (from_tenant,to_tenant,reason,intent_id).
elaine: CRD suggestion for operator config: spec.operator.allowed_burst_pct, spec.operator.ramp_pct_per_window, spec.operator.fallback.reserve_pct, spec.operator.intent_ttl_seconds. Gate rollout with control-plane feature flag.
hugo: Tests: deterministic sim with 200 tenants, spike patterns, and 5-10m control-plane partitions; measure preempt churn, fairness delta, and latency SLO violations. Store sims under infra-sims repo and attach results to RFC.
mike: Action items: mike -> intent API + proto draft; elaine -> metrics + dashboard + alerts; hugo -> CRD + fallback impl + tests; ops-bot -> schedule nightly sim.
ops-bot: Nightly job scheduled: dedicated-pool-sim -> staging (start 03:00 UTC).
ops-bot: Deployment queued: mike/intent-proto-draft -> staging :rocket:
mike: Will fold this into the RFC follow-up and open PRs tomorrow unless there are objections.
elaine: No blockers from infra/security.
hugo: +1, prefer alpha rollout to a single region first.
mike: Thanks all.
